description: Wave 0 adversarial English pass over the 10 keys wave0_keyset.php --new-and-changed leaves for review (49 new or changed; 39 already ruled by Tom on their exact English: the mode prompts, the Task 808 strings and 27 count strings in the "cells (n)" form). Each string was asked for every plausible reading. One entry filed; the other nine read one way only.

entries.complaint: "N/A" is read as "not available" as often as "not applicable"; a translator may render the wrong abbreviation.
readings: not applicable (the quantity has no meaning here)
entries.resolution: The key name says not_applicable and the payload carries it; it fills a results cell for side-slope rock size on a vertical wall, where the quantity has no meaning. Translators use their language's short form of "not applicable".
